saw_lines: Shoppers buying food, natural cosmetics or crafts want to know who made it, and gift buyers decide fast.
So the sale is decided on the first screen, where a new buyer needs a reason to order.
Your 0 live Meta ads leave new buyers unreached, so launch three Meta ads for your best sellers with a first order offer.
ads_1: First order offer ads with product video, tested against a maker origin story
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
